mapper.select: SELECT BRAND_CD, BRAND_NM FROM TBL_BRAND
SELECT * FROM TBL_CATEGORY WHERE USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY SORT_ORDER
SELECT * FROM TBL_CATEGORY WHERE UP_CATEGORY_NO = #{categoryNo} AND USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY SORT_ORDER
SELECT SEQ_PROD_NO.CURRVAL FROM DUAL
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT A.PROD_NO) FROM TBL_PRODUCT A LEFT JOIN TBL_CATEGORY B ON A.CATEGORY_NO = B.CATEGORY_NO LEFT JOIN TBL_BRAND C ON A.BRAND_CD = C.BRAND_CD WHERE 1 = 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT A.PROD_NO) FROM TBL_PRODUCT A LEFT JOIN TBL_CATEGORY B ON(A.CATEGORY_NO = B.CATEGORY_NO) LEFT JOIN TBL_BRAND C ON(A.BRAND_CD = C.BRAND_CD) WHERE A.USE_YN = 'Y'

SELECT A.PROD_NO , A.PROD_NM , A.CATEGORY_NO , B.CATEGORY_NM , B.UP_CATEGORY_NO , A.BRAND_CD , C.BRAND_NM , A.PROD_DESC , A.DISCOUNT_RATE , A.PRICE , A.PROD_DETAIL_CONTENT , A.INS_DT , A.UPT_DT , A.USE_YN FROM TBL_PRODUCT A LEFT JOIN TBL_CATEGORY B ON(A.CATEGORY_NO = B.CATEGORY_NO) LEFT JOIN TBL_BRAND C ON(A.BRAND_CD = C.BRAND_CD) WHERE A.PROD_NO = #{ prodNo }
SELECT REF_PROD_NO , THUMBNAIL_PATH , SAVE_PATH FROM TBL_ATTACHMENT WHERE ATTACH_STATUS_YN = 'Y' AND FILE_TYPE = 'THUMB_MAIN' AND REF_PROD_NO = #{ prodNo }
SELECT REF_PROD_NO , THUMBNAIL_PATH , SAVE_PATH FROM TBL_ATTACHMENT WHERE ATTACH_STATUS_YN = 'Y' AND FILE_TYPE = 'THUMB_SUB' AND REF_PROD_NO = #{ prodNo }

SELECT A.PROD_NO , A.OPT_NAME_NO , A.OPT_NAME_NM , B.OPT_VALUE_NO , B.OPT_VALUE_NM FROM TBL_OPTION_NAME A INNER JOIN TBL_OPTION_VALUE B ON A.OPT_NAME_NO = B.OPT_NAME_NO WHERE A.PROD_NO = #{ prodNo } ORDER BY A.SORT_ORDER, B.SORT_ORDER
SELECT OPT_COMB_NO , OPT_ADD_PRICE , OPT_STOCK_QTY , OPT_MANAGE_NM FROM TBL_OPTION_COMB WHERE prod_no = #{ prodNo } AND OPT_SALE_STATUS = 'Y'
SELECT OPT_COMB_NO , PROD_NO , OPT_ADD_PRICE , OPT_STOCK_QTY , OPT_MANAGE_NM , OPT_SALE_STATUS FROM TBL_OPTION_COMB WHERE PROD_NO = #{prodNo} AND OPT_MANAGE_NM = #{combName}

SELECT A.REVIEW_NO , A.PROD_NO , A.OPT_COMB_NO , A.ORDER_ITEM_NO , SUBSTR(A.MEMBER_ID, 1, 4) || RPAD('*', LENGTH(A.MEMBER_ID)-4, '*') MEMBER_ID , A.REVW_CONTENT , A.REVW_REG_DATE , A.REVW_RATINGS , B.THUMBNAIL_PATH , C.OPT_ADD_PRICE , C.OPT_MANAGE_NM , D.PROD_NM FROM TBL_REVIEW A LEFT JOIN TBL_ATTACHMENT B ON(A.REVIEW_NO = B.REF_REVW_NO) LEFT JOIN TBL_OPTION_COMB C ON(A.OPT_COMB_NO = C.OPT_COMB_NO) LEFT JOIN TBL_PRODUCT D ON(C.PROD_NO = D.PROD_NO) WHERE C.PROD_NO = #{prodNo} ORDER BY A.REVW_REG_DATE DESC

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT(A.REVIEW_NO)) FROM TBL_REVIEW A LEFT JOIN TBL_ATTACHMENT B ON(A.REVIEW_NO = B.REF_REVW_NO) LEFT JOIN TBL_OPTION_COMB C ON(A.OPT_COMB_NO = C.OPT_COMB_NO) LEFT JOIN TBL_PRODUCT D ON(C.PROD_NO = D.PROD_NO) WHERE D.PROD_NO = #{prodNo}

SELECT ROUND(AVG(RATING), 1) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT(A.REVIEW_NO) , A.REVW_RATINGS AS RATING FROM TBL_REVIEW A LEFT JOIN TBL_ATTACHMENT B ON(A.REVIEW_NO = B.REF_REVW_NO) LEFT JOIN TBL_OPTION_COMB C ON(A.OPT_COMB_NO = C.OPT_COMB_NO) LEFT JOIN TBL_PRODUCT D ON(C.PROD_NO = D.PROD_NO) WHERE D.PROD_NO = #{prodNo})
SELECT A.PROD_NO FROM TBL_PRODUCT A INNER JOIN TBL_PRODUCT_COMB B ON A.PROD_NO = B.PROD_NO GROUP BY A.PROD_NO, A.PROD_NM, A.CATEGORY_NO HAVING COUNT(B.PROD_COMB_NO) >= 2

SELECT B.PROD_NO , B.PROD_NM , B.BRAND_CD , C.BRAND_NM , B.PRICE , B.DISCOUNT_RATE , B.PROD_DESC , B.TAG , D.SAVE_PATH , D.THUMBNAIL_PATH FROM TBL_PRODUCT B INNER JOIN TBL_BRAND C ON B.BRAND_CD = C.BRAND_CD LEFT JOIN TBL_ATTACHMENT D ON B.PROD_NO = D.REF_PROD_NO AND D.FILE_TYPE = 'THUMB_MAIN' WHERE B.PROD_NO = #{ prodNo }

SELECT B.PROD_NO , B.PROD_NM , B.BRAND_CD , C.BRAND_NM , B.PRICE , B.DISCOUNT_RATE , B.PROD_DESC , B.TAG , D.SAVE_PATH , D.THUMBNAIL_PATH FROM TBL_PRODUCT_COMB A INNER JOIN TBL_PRODUCT B ON A.PROD_COMB_NO = B.PROD_NO INNER JOIN TBL_BRAND C ON B.BRAND_CD = C.BRAND_CD LEFT JOIN TBL_ATTACHMENT D ON b.PROD_NO = D.REF_PROD_NO AND D.FILE_TYPE = 'THUMB_MAIN' WHERE B.USE_YN = 'Y' AND A.PROD_NO = #{ prodNo }
